newsitem.title: MEXICO: Two Mexico crude ports shut amid high winds -ports.
newsitem.headline: Two Mexico crude ports shut amid high winds -ports.

text.p: Two of Mexico's main crude shipping ports were reported shut early Tuesday because of high winds and waves in the Gulf of Mexico, port authorities said Tuesday.
Dos Bocas in Tabasco state closed 0430 local/1030 GMT as waves reached 10 to 12 feet high.
Pajaritos in Veracruz state remained closed after shutting at 1400 local/2000 GMT.
The ports reopened early Monday after a weekend closure, but were again shut later in the day.
The largest of Mexico's crude ports, Cayo Arcas in Campeche state, remained open despite the cold front in the Gulf of Mexico.

According to the latest figures from state oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex), Cayo Arcas ships an average 611,000 barrels per day (bpd), Dos Bocas ships 440,000 bpd and Pajaritos ships 399,000 bpd.
